verdict.rationale: Pandoc is a CLI tool and Haskell library with an HTTP server mode, so an interactive API reference is a fair thing to ask of it. The evidence shows no such reference: the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, and the documentation cited is a static manual. The limited online demo and WebAssembly demo are conversion playgrounds, not an API reference with runnable examples, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.
